experimental_design: Comparison between FgPacC30-GFP bait and GFP-only control to identify interacting proteins

To perform affinity capture-mass spectrometry analysis, the functional isoform FgPacC (FgPacC30) was tagged with GFP and transformed into the ΔFgPacC mutant... Furthermore, ΔFgPacC transformed with GFP fragment was used as a control for exclusion of nonspecific affinity proteins.
